info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Submission Amendment-spec
info.description: The Submission Amendment Management API enables users to submit amendments for existing regulatory submissions, ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. This API allows financial institutions to maintain accurate records and adjust prior submissions as needed. Typical consumers include compliance officers and financial analysts who manage regulatory reporting and require flexibility in submitting amendments. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their regulatory processes and improve their response to changing compliance obligations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit amendments for a specific regulatory submission identified by its ID. Ensure that all necessary fields are correctly provided in the request body to process the amendment successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit amendments for the specified regulatory reporting submission identified by RES-100045. The payload must adhere to the defined schema and should include all necessary fields for the amendment process.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.
